The skill is a legitimate utility for generating privacy policy templates (GDPR, CCPA, etc.). llm.guidance: This appears to be a straightforward local privacy-policy generator and is coherent with its description. Before running the supplied script: 1) review the entire scripts/privacy.sh file (the provided excerpt was truncated) for any network calls (curl/wget/nc/ssh), file reads/writes outside its own directory, or hardcoded endpoints; 2) do not run the script as root—run in a sandbox or VM if you want to be cautious; 3) check for executable permissions and scan with your usual tools (shellcheck, antivirus) if desired; 4) remember the generated policy is a template only (the script itself includes a disclaimer) — have a lawyer review for legal compliance.
